description: Source code for OvsDbApi JSON parser and monitor update handling, including functions for creating JSON messages for database operations and parsing incoming JSON messages related to OVS database monitoring.

methods.name: ovsdb_insert_to_json
methods.description: Converts a table configuration into a JSON string for insertion based on table type.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_to_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON string to start monitoring a specific OVS table.

methods.name: ovsdb_monitor_cancel_to_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON string to cancel monitoring of a specific monitor ID.

methods.name: ovsdb_delete_to_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON string to delete a record from a specified OVS table based on key and value.

methods.name: ovsdb_parse_msg
methods.description: Parses incoming JSON messages, handling monitor updates or responses based on message content.

methods.name: ovsdb_parse_params
methods.description: Processes the 'params' array from a JSON message, extracting UUIDs and updates.

methods.name: ovsdb_parse_monitor_update
methods.description: Parses individual monitor update objects, updating internal structures accordingly.
